motion_metrics.protocol: Raw teacher-forced predictions; episode-local nonoverlapping prefixes; each valid action once; training episodes measure fitting only.
motion_metrics.baseline_contract: Hold uses observed pose/joints and gripper at the inference anchor; persistence repeats the prior achieved delta/recorded target and holds the anchor gripper. Tool deltas are transported between observed tool frames. Neither uses future observations.
motion_metrics.geometry_caution: Cartesian metrics inherit the prepared FK calibration; joint metrics are degrees, not Cartesian task error.

offline_selection.weights: equal mean of available components; thresholds fixed before training
offline_selection.scope: offline shortlist only; same split, targets, normalization and component availability required for comparison
offline_selection.promotion: requires bounded common development rollouts, then frozen reserved evaluation; offline score establishes no task success

causal_input_audit.selection: For each exact 13-component proprioception group in each selected training episode, compare its final tick with the closest earlier tick whose first Cartesian label differs by more than 0.4 mm. Current images are compared only after selection; no model outcome is used.
causal_input_audit.interpretation: Identical current proprioception can precede different recorded next actions, including hold-to-motion onset. Images are similar but not identical; this does not prove irreducible error for the full visual policy. The deterministic 25-action/2-second loss predicts much farther than the two-action/0.16-second execution prefix. Future operator timing is not an explicit input. These are possible contributors, not an established cause or excuse for failed fitting.
